comment: Frame 039: a plate: the facsimile, in a line block, of a page of the manuscript with the demonstration of the fifth case, a square and twenty-one dirhams equal ten roots, from «مثل احد اضلاع سطح اد» to its end, with the figure of the demonstration below the text, a note in the top margin, and the catchword «واما» at the foot. It follows printed p. 24 (frame 038); its verso (frame 040) is blank.
observations: The facsimile is reproduced as an image; its handwritten text is not transcribed. Its lines correspond to the edition's text from frame 038, L02, to the end of the demonstration on frame 041.

The manuscript names the point at which the line حه is halved with ج, a jīm with its dot: «على نقطة ج» and «خط هج» in the fifth line of the page, where the print has ع (frame 038, L07; critical note AK01-CN003). In the first line it writes the label هن with the ن upright (frame 038, L02; critical note AK01-CN004).
